title: UK production and supply of the Food Origins baskets (Defra, annual; national context)
referencePeriod: tomatoes 2025, potatoes 2025 (provisional), strawberries 2025, apples 2025, wheat 2025 (provisional), beef 2025, sheep-goat 2025, poultry 2025, sugar 2025 (provisional)
coverage: United Kingdom; tomatoes, potatoes, strawberries, apples, wheat, beef and veal, sheep and goat meat, poultry meat, sugar (no Defra supply balance used: oranges, bananas, rice, milk products (not cheese), cheese, coffee, cocoa)
attribution: Source: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0

retrieval.method: Read offline from the committed Defra datasets (fetch-reference --set context, --set trade)
retrieval.notes: Values as published (Agriculture in the UK shares converted from fractions to per cent; imports and exports are the sums of Defra's EU and rest-of-the-world rows where it splits them). Annual and national: never combined with HMRC monthly trade.
